text:
rachel: Quick heads-up — VoltEdge asked for a joint perf/W + throughput quick-run next week. Goal: marketplace listing numbers + short release blog. Need kernel tuning support, perf counters, and a telemetry handshake.

jonas: Do we have lab VPN and creds for their rigs yet? Also what sample model/seq length are we using?

kevin: We got the S3 creds from voltedge-labs last night but VPN still pending. Proposed model: gpt-small-1 @ 2k token context (we'll test 512/2048 as slices). Perf matrix: report perf/W at steady-state + throughput at 95/99p latency.

ash: Kernel tuning scope: fused attention vs stock, cuBLAS kernel variants, FP16 vs int8 quant paths. Plan: baseline (no quant), int8, q4_0. Also include KV-cache thrash test to catch writeback regressions.

maria: Telemetry list — we need host power (PDU), per-socket package power, perf counters (instructions/cycle, L2 miss), runtime traces, kernel dmesg, and per-request latency. Minimal schema below.

rachel: Can you paste the schema here? I'll use it for the partner onboarding doc.

maria: ```json
{"run_id":"string","ts":1234567890,"host":{"pdu_w":123.4,"socket_w":[60.2,63.1]},"gpu":{"power_w":95.6,"util_pct":87},"latency_ms":{"p50":12.3,"p95":45.6,"p99":80.2},"counters":{"inst_per_cycle":0.72}}
```

rachel: Ok — owners: Jonas (bench ops), Kevin (kernel tuning), Maria (telemetry/analysis), Rachel (PM/announce). Agree?

jonas: :thumbsup: I can run a dry-run Wed and full sweep Thu-Fri. Need partner to allow perfmon & kernel debug. I'll ping @volteng (Alex) to flip the flags.

kevin: We'll need driver/stack versions pinned for reproducibility. Candidate stack: nvidia-driver 535.86, CUDA 12.1, cuBLAS 12.x. If VoltEdge can't change drivers, we do a compatibility matrix and mark it in the notes.

bench-bot: Scheduled run created: 1715011200. Tests queued: baseline / int8 / q4_0. Notifying participants.

maria: On data sharing — partner asked for raw traces. Legal will likely require an NDA addendum for raw dumps. Rachel, can you escalate to legal? We can share aggregated CSVs & heatmaps without addendum.

rachel: Looping in legal separately. For announcement cadence, VoltEdge is aiming for a blog the week after the run — so we need final numbers + sign-off by next Mon. Is that feasible?

ash: If we parallelize across 4 rigs, a full sweep (3 quant modes x 3 workloads x 3 repeats) is ~8h runtime. With tuning iterations add ~1-2 days. So timeline looks like: Wed dry-run, Thu tuning, Fri final sweep.

jonas: Action items: 1) Alex (VoltEdge) to enable perfmon & VPN by Tue EOD. 2) Bench ops to prep runner scripts and test harness. 3) Kernel team to provide tuning knobs and safe defaults. 4) PM to draft release playbook & legal ask.

jonas: runner snippet:
```bash
run-bench --model gpt-small-1 --seq 2048 --duration 3600 \\n  --telemetry s3://redwood-partner-voltedge/bench-1715009999 \\n  --mode baseline,int8,q4_0
```

kevin: Also add regression checks to the harness: token-level BLEU-ish or logprobs delta. Don't want quality regressions from quant.

maria: Dropping the telemetry bucket: s3://redwood-partner-voltedge/bench-1715009999 (write perms granted to voltedge-acc@).

rachel: I'll draft the embargoed blog playbook (contents, quotes, logo rules) and share this afternoon. Marketing can be included but we'd keep the draft internal until sign-off.

jonas: I'll build a quick dashboard in the Console for per-route latency + power graphs and share link after the dry-run.

rachel: Great — if no blockers I'll send the kickoff note to Alex and flip the bench-bot to start. Thanks all!
